verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB says each agent run can get its own branch of production data on isolated compute over the same S3, which the agent can experiment on and then throw away. It also offers isolated read-only agent compute that cannot affect production traffic, plus a free dev instance for testing. Together these directly describe a sandbox separate from production. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how branching works (write isolation, creation and teardown commands or API), confirmation that branch writes never reach production data, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing-page claims.
